cleared_by.what_changed:
GREEN, measured six ways 2026-08-17. THE CORPUS WAS THE RED, and the corpus was fixed: all six tickets were re-fired through /sorted's door, which judged the spec the hand could not.

(1) `python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_watchme_spec.py` against the live tree: 14/14 green, run twice. (2) Clean git worktree of cairn HEAD f20f25d: 14/14 green, run twice. (3) The sweep reads /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets — 146 tickets, 0 red. (4) Each of the six now carries a NAMED WATCHME object in its state string, a spec joined to that object by the gate's own join key, and a sorted_berth: a-bulk-move-forwards-itself-from-gits-own-rename-record (the_derivation_keeps_up_with_the_rename_record), probescan-resolves-the-real-shim-not-a-discovered-one (probescans_device_column_varies_with_the_world), surveys-floor-keys-on-names-while-orient-hands-it-paths (surveys_floor_produced_a_row_for_every_component_ref), the-beat-spends-2500ms-on-triggers-against-a-1s-cadence (the_beat_stays_inside_its_cadence), the-buildme-gates-guard-a-crossing-not-a-state (no_component_reaches_proved_with_an_uncharted_build), a-validate-criterion-is-runnable-before-the-crossing (the_refusal_names_a_criterion_a_builder_would_have_shipped). (5) The non-vacuity tooth test_the_clean_sweep_is_not_a_vacuous_check is green under its own bit>20 floor, so the sweep's clean result is caused by the stated exemptions and not by a rule that stopped firing. (6) Both repos clean at HEAD — cairn f20f25d, CairnCommons cf59098.

WHAT THE RED ACTUALLY SAID, and the trouble said it correctly: the tooth exists to prove the spec gate does not retro-red pre-existing tickets, so its failure was evidence about the CORPUS, never about the gate. Nothing in watchme_spec.py was touched.

THE POPULATION IS THE FINDING. Five of the six shared one shape — four 2026-08-14 casts each carrying a bare `WATCHME` (parsed WATCHME(None): a summons naming no object, which no spec can ever match) and one 2026-08-15 cast carrying no `watchme` key at all. All five also carried a null or absent `sorted_berth`, so buildme_rides_the_sorted would have refused every one of them at their first crossing — including, with some symmetry, the ticket about that very edge. The trouble's own note guessed right at n=5 ('likely one authoring path, not five slips'): each was written by copying a sibling, so a missing field PROPAGATED rather than recurring, and a check that reads one artifact cannot see that.

RESIDUE, MEASURED RATHER THAN REASONED — three items, and none of them is this trouble.

(a) THE OBLIGATION IS NOW RECORDED, NOT DISCHARGED. Five of the six sit at [TICKETME] and their probe berths are ABSENT — checked, 5 of 5 paths do not exist on disk. That is the correct resting state, not a defect: a probe arms before the WATCHME crossing, which happens at build time. What changed is that the obligation is now gate-readable, so the emission gate can refuse an unarmed crossing instead of stepping over a summons with no object. The sixth, the bulk-move ticket, is the only one that has actually run the route: it is at [PROVED] with its probe armed at cairn/machines/build_inspector/probes/does_the_derivation_keep_up.py.

(b) NOTHING STOPS THE NEXT HAND CAST FROM DOING THIS AGAIN. /sorted's door judges PACKETS; a ticket file written by hand never touches it. Two things catch it afterwards — this corpus census, which is what found it, and buildme_rides_the_sorted at the ticket's first crossing — and both are downstream of the defect already existing on disk. Unchanged by this clear, and named here so nobody re-derives it.

(c) A FRAGILITY MEASURED IN PASSING, WITH THE GUARD HOLDING. watchme_spec._TICKETS is derived from the module's own location (_REPO_ROOT.parent / 'CairnCommons' / 'tickets'), so a git worktree placed anywhere but as a sibling of CairnCommons reads a corpus that does not exist. Measured directly: a worktree under the scratchpad returned 12/14 with 'the sweep found only 0 tickets — it is not reading the real corpus'. The proof's own len(rows) > 40 floor turned what would otherwise have been a vacuous green into a loud red — the instrument caught its own blind spot, which is exactly the shape a hollow green would have taken. The clean-worktree measurement in (2) was re-run as a sibling of CairnCommons for this reason.

WHAT THIS CLEAR DOES NOT CLAIM: that the five new specs are GOOD. What is measured is that they are complete, gate-readable, and judged by the door — object, trigger, enough, carrier, nexus, consumer, probe berth. Whether each watch would actually tell us its intention worked is answered by the watch itself, later, against the ticket's own falsifier. No design was reopened; every falsifier was transcribed, not rewritten.
